title: Dual-phase engineering of CF<sub>x</sub> electrode and <mark>interphase</mark> enables low-temperature Li||CF<sub>x</sub> batteries
abstract: Published online: 25 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-76513-4 Li||CFx batteries exhibit severe low-temperature degradation owing to insulating CFx electrodes and sluggish Li+ kinetics. The authors propose a dual-modification strategy combining carbon-coated porous CFx cathodes with an electrolyte-derived <mark>interphase</mark>, which accelerates Li+ transport and boosts performance at low temperatures.

title: Cryogenic energy storage enabled by dipole glass with unit-cell-level polar disorder
abstract: Published online: 24 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s41565-026-02260-8 A dipole glass with unit-cell-scale polar disorder, nanoengineered near the antiferroelectric–paraelectric phase boundary, enables dielectric energy storage with high <mark>energy density</mark> and efficiency from 300 K to 4 K, addressing a key limitation of relaxor ferroelectrics at cryogenic temperatures.

abstract: α-Ni(OH)2 has emerged as a promising alternative for commercial β-Ni(OH)2 in nickel-based batteries owing to its superior theoretical <mark>specific capacity</mark>.
